name: SLF Representation via B-Spline Wavelets
aliases: Surface Light Field (SLF) Representation using B-Spline Wavelets
definition: Approximates the view map f(ω|p) at each point p as a linear combination of N basis functions to compress the Surface Light Field (SLF).
summary: SLF Representation via B-Spline Wavelets approximates surface light fields using continuous wavelets to enable efficient compression and rendering without the discretization errors inherent in grid-based methods.
